content.text:
```yaml
package_name: macports
slots:
  - category: identity
    name: name
    value: MacPorts
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Title"

  - category: identity
    name: version
    value: "2.11.6"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"

  - category: identity
    name: description
    value: "An easy to use system for compiling, installing, and managing open source software"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Meta description"

  - category: identity
    name: homepage
    value: "https://www.macports.org/"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - URL"

  - category: platform
    name: supported_platforms
    value: ["darwin"]
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS-specific installation"
    annotation: "Primarily developed for macOS, some experimental support for other POSIX platforms"

  - category: platform
    name: supported_versions
    value: ["26", "15", "14", "13", "12", "11", "10.15", "10.14", "10.13", "10.12"]
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Quickstart section"
    annotation: "macOS versions from Tahoe (26) down to Sierra (10.12)"

  - category: dependency
    name: required_packages
    value: ["xcode-command-line-tools"]
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Quickstart section"

  - category: installation
    name: install_command
    value: "xcode-select --install"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Quickstart section"
    annotation: "First install Apple's Command Line Developer Tools"

  - category: installation
    name: pkg_installers
    value: 
      - url: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/MacPorts-2.11.6-26-Tahoe.pkg"
        version: "Tahoe v26"
      - url: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/MacPorts-2.11.6-15-Sequoia.pkg"
        version: "Sequoia v15"
      - url: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/MacPorts-2.11.6-14-Sonoma.pkg"
        version: "Sonoma v14"
      - url: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/MacPorts-2.11.6-13-Ventura.pkg"
        version: "Ventura v13"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"

  - category: installation
    name: source_install
    value: 
      - "cd MacPorts-2.11.6"
      - "./configure && make && sudo make install"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Source Installation section"

  - category: installation
    name: source_tarball
    value: 
      - "https://distfiles.macports.org/MacPorts/MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.bz2"
      - "https://distfiles.macports.org/MacPorts/MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.gz"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"

  - category: installation
    name: git_install
    value: "git clone https://github.com/macports/macports-base.git"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"

  - category: configuration
    name: shell_setup
    value: 
      - "Add ${prefix}/bin and ${prefix}/sbin to the start of your PATH environment variable"
      - "Add the ${prefix}/share/man path to MANPATH if it exists"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Source Installation section"
    annotation: "Required for source installs, automatic for pkg installs"

  - category: configuration
    name: xcode_license_acceptance
    value: "xcodebuild -license"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts section"
    annotation: "Required with Xcode 4 and later"

  - category: configuration
    name: post_install_update
    value: "sudo port -v selfupdate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer section"
    annotation: "Recommended to run regularly to keep current"

  - category: verification
    name: verify_command
    value: "port version"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Guide Document - macOS Package Install section"

  - category: verification
    name: expected_output
    value: "Version: 2.11.6"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Guide Document - macOS Package Install section"

  - category: feature
    name: selfupdate
    value: "sudo port selfupdate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Selfupdate section"
    annotation: "Upgrades to latest release if no restrictions on rsync protocol"

  - category: feature
    name: migration_support
    value: "sudo port migrate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "Migration Document - Migration procedure section"
    annotation: "Available in MacPorts 2.10.0 or later for OS upgrades"

  - category: setting
    name: default_prefix
    value: "/opt/local"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Source Installation section"

  - category: setting
    name: rsync_port
    value: "873"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Selfupdate section"
    annotation: "tcp port 873 by default for rsync networking protocol"

  - category: conflict
    name: incompatible_with
    value: ["/usr/local software", "/Library/Frameworks installations"]
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - General Questions section"
    annotation: "Software in /usr/local or /Library/Frameworks can interfere with MacPorts builds"

sources:
  - title: "MacPorts Download & Installation"
    url: "https://www.macports.org/install.php"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used: ["Quickstart", "Installing MacPorts", "macOS Package (.pkg) Installer", "Source Installation"]

  - title: "MacPorts Migration Guide"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used: ["Migration procedure", "Troubleshooting"]

  - title: "MacPorts FAQ"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/FAQ"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used: ["General Questions"]

  - title: "MacPorts Guide"
    url: "https://guide.macports.org"
    trust_level: vendor
    sections_used: ["Installing MacPorts", "macOS Package Install"]

ambiguities:
  - slot_name: xcode_requirement
    description: "Not clear if full Xcode installation is required or just command line tools"
    options: 
      - "Only command line tools needed for most ports"
      - "Full Xcode required for some specific ports"
    suggested_default: "Command line tools sufficient for most use cases, full Xcode optional"

tribal_knowledge:
  - title: "Avoid /usr/local contamination"
    description: "MacPorts uses /opt/local specifically to avoid conflicts with software installed in /usr/local, which can cause build failures"
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - General Questions"
    affects_phase: install

  - title: "Shell environment setup automatic for pkg installs"
    description: "The pkg installer automatically modifies shell configuration files, but source installs require manual PATH setup"
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer"
    affects_phase: provision

  - title: "Migration required for major OS upgrades"
    description: "MacPorts installations don't work across major macOS upgrades and require migration procedure to rebuild ports for new OS"
    source_ref: "Migration Document"
    affects_phase: install

  - title: "Regular selfupdate recommended"
    description: "Should run 'sudo port selfupdate' regularly to keep MacPorts base and ports tree current"
    source_ref: "Primary Document - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer"
    affects_phase: install

  - title: "Xcode license must be accepted"
    description: "After installing Xcode 4 or later, must accept license either by launching Xcode or running 'xcodebuild -license'"
    source_ref: "Primary Document - Installing MacPorts"
    affects_phase: prepare

  - title: "Trace mode for contaminated systems"
    description: "If /usr/local software exists, can use 'sudo port -t install <portname>' to hide it during builds"
    source_ref: "FAQ Document - General Questions"
    affects_phase: install
```
